name: @digitaplatform/signature-kit
description: Internal, never-published build tool that makes a SIGNATURE-type plugin from one input file (signature.json): the Signature object, its light and dark colour world, its background graphics as SVG, its mark and wordmark, and a WCAG AA check of every text and control pair the kit draws. `make-signature` writes src/index.ts and assets/*.svg of a signature package and refuses an input that fails the check.
